title: Can’t manually create blend triangles in BlendSpace2D
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 4GB Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1355U (12 threads) - 15.71 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The issue is about not being able to create own blending triangles in the Editor with the press of the button “Create triangles by connecting points.” and manually connecting points to a blending triangle by hand. Once you press on the button on the toolbar and then click on a point, the tool shows a line to indicate that you can connect points, but the moment its activated, Godot immediately auto-connects all the points by itself again and regenerates the same triangles that were deleted before and recreating the overlapping triangles on top of it if the autoconnection created the pattern beforehand:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8e41735b-9b91-4ccc-9e6b-8138b35a79df

Manual patching and reconnecting points is not possible this way, especially in the case if the autoconnection of Godot sometimes create overlapping triangles as seen in the video.

There is no specific error found or displayed in the Output Dock

### Steps to reproduce

This happened in the AnimationTree Tab: 
1.Add an AnimationTree node to the scene, create a new AnimationNodeBlendspace2D in the Tree Root, switch to the AnimationTree Tab at the bottom.
2.Edit the new Blendspace2D
3.At the top of the toolbar press the button "Generate blend triangles automatically (instead of manually)" to deactivate it.
4.The "Create triangles by connecting points.” Button now appears.
5.Press the button "Select and move points" and add 5 animations and spread them out, the points should not be connected.
6.Press "Create triangles by connecting points.”, press on a point and see if a line appears that you can drag to another point and create a triangle manually.
7.If Godot already autoconnects those points and you then press a point a line should appear that indicates that you can connect it to another point. After clicking on the points you should get a warning message "Triangle already exist"
8.Press the button "Select and move points", press inside the triangles and delete them. 
9.Press "Create triangles by connecting points.” again and try to connect the points manually in a different order. It should not be possible since Godot already auto-connects the points with the same triangle pattern again, thus preventing you from connecting the points manually.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31035302/new-game-project.zip)
